top_violation_types.title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An updated immunization record is needed for one child enrolled.

top_violation_types.title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the walk through a trash can with food waste was observed in reach of children and accessible.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the DFPS investigation, a child was disciplined by pinching their ear, which resulted in bruising.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A sampling of children records were evaluated. One child's immunization record was observed incomplete.

top_violation_types.title: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Continuity of Care Until Children Released (26 TAC §746.5202(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The emergency preparedness plan does not state how children will be cared for during the emergency.

top_violation_types.title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation is missing how they would evacuate children younger then 24 months out of the operation doing an emergency.
